results.rationale:
The provided documentation does not explicitly state any maximum interrupt response and processing time for incoming CAN messages. The sections discuss mailbox management, FIFO handling, and filtering mechanisms but do not provide specific timing guarantees relevant to the requirement.

Evidence:
[RM0008 p.664 §24.7.3 Reception handling] "If the FIFO lock function is disabled (RFLM bit in the CAN_MCR register cleared) the last message stored in the FIFO will be overwritten by the new incoming message. In this case the latest messages will be always available to the application."
[RM0008 p.655 §24.3.4 Acceptance filters] "Two receive FIFOs are used by hardware to store the incoming messages. Three complete messages can be stored in each FIFO. The FIFOs are managed completely by hardware."
results.comments: The documentation discusses mailbox and FIFO management but does not provide specific timing guarantees for interrupt response and processing of CAN messages.
